Records.description: Two-loop planar four-point integral family relevant for NNLO QCD corrections to $t\bar{t}$ hadroproduction, with seven inverse propagators (one massive top line $D_5$) and two ISPs $D_8, D_9$, used as the worked AMFlow example. Four top-sector integrals $j[tt,1,1,1,1,1,1,1,-3,0]$, $j[tt,1,1,1,1,1,1,1,-2,-1]$, $j[tt,1,1,1,1,1,1,1,-1,-2]$, $j[tt,1,1,1,1,1,1,1,0,-3]$ are computed numerically from $\varepsilon^{-4}$ to $\varepsilon^0$ with 20-digit precision at the kinematic point $s=30$, $t=-10/3$, $m^2=1$, using SolveIntegrals (automatic mode) and BlackBoxAMFlow followed by FitEps (manual mode). IBP reduction is performed via FiniteFlow+LiteRed (default), FIRE+LiteRed, or Kira; values flow via auxiliary mass to vacuum boundary integrals.
Records.location: Section 3, Fig. 4 (fig:tt), Eqs. (3.1)-(3.2); example in examples/automatic_vs_manual/run.wl

Records.description: Top-branch T1F of Family A for NNLO QCD corrections to $qq\to W^+W^-$ with top-quark propagators. Planar double-box with one massive internal line ($m_t$). Called $T_{1,\operatorname{digamma}}$ in the paper. Canonical DEs with 14 symbol letters and one square root $r=\sqrt{x(x-4z)}$. Crossed families from $p_1\leftrightarrow p_2$ not listed separately.

Records.description: Two-loop planar double-box integral family for NNLO QCD corrections to ttbar hadroproduction (paper label: tt). Seven inverse propagators (one massive internal line D5) and two ISPs (D8, D9). External momenta: p1, p2 massless; p3, p4 massive (p3^2=p4^2=m^2). Four top-sector integrals computed numerically from eps^-4 to eps^0 with 20-digit precision at s=30, t=-10/3, m^2=1, using both automatic (SolveIntegrals) and manual (BlackBoxAMFlow+FitEps) workflows. IBP reduction via FiniteFlow+LiteRed, FIRE+LiteRed, or Kira.
Records.location: Section 3, Fig. 4 (fig:tt), Eqs. (3.1)-(3.2); example in examples/automatic_vs_manual/run.wl

Records.description: Planar two-loop double-box topology for tW single-top production $b(k_1)+g(k_2) \to W(k_3)+t(k_4)$. Seven propagators: $D_1$-$D_6$ massless, $D_7 = q_2^2 - m_t^2$ carrying top mass. On-shell conditions $k_1^2=k_2^2=0$, $k_3^2=m_W^2$, $k_4^2=m_t^2$. Four independent scales: $s_1=2k_1.k_2$, $s_2=m_W^2-2k_1.k_3$, $m_W$, $m_t$. Paper improves auxiliary-mass-flow (AMF) reduction method via an epsilon-truncation in the matching step; reduces the $F_1$ form factor to 198 scalar integrals via FIRE+LiteRed cross-checked against Tarasov tensor reduction.
Records.familyName: 1-mass two-loop 4-point planar double box (tW single-top production, 7 propagators)

Records.description: Non-planar (crossed) two-loop four-point integral family for $g(k_1) b(k_2) \to W(k_3) t(k_4)$ with one massive (top) propagator. Nine denominators $P_1..P_9$ are defined, with $P_1..P_7$ the top-sector propagators and $P_8, P_9$ irreducible scalar products. IBP reduction with FIRE gives 34 master integrals. A canonical basis is constructed and the differential equations brought to dln form using the same 15 letters as the planar family plus two additional letters $l_{16} = x^2 z + x y + z$ and $l_{17} = x^2 z^3 + x y(z^2-1) + 2 x z^2 + z^3$. The square root $r_1$ is rationalized by the same variables $(x, y, z)$. Fifteen non-planar masters coincide with planar ones (listed explicitly: $B_1..B_5$, $B_9 = -F_{23}$, $B_{10}, B_{11}, B_{12}, B_{13}, B_{14}, B_{19}, B_{20}, B_{23}, B_{24}$). Remaining boundaries are determined by vanishing at $u=0$, $u=m_W^2$, $t=m_t^2$, $u=m_t^2$, $s=0$, $s=(m_t+m_W)^2$, and $l_{17}=0$, by regularity at $u t = m_t^2 m_W^2$, and by the known result of Gonsalves for the massless non-planar double box.
